subquestions.text: List the three types of relationships that can be represented in an ER diagram for the vehicle rental system scenario.

subquestions.label: b
subquestions.text: Design an EER model for the vehicle rental system scenario, including the ternary relationship between customers, vehicles, and payments. Ensure that all relationships are necessary and represent different meanings. Also, include the binary relationships as required.

questions.text:
a) List the three types of relationships that can be represented in an ER diagram for the vehicle rental system scenario. (5 marks)
b) Design an EER model for the vehicle rental system scenario, including the ternary relationship between customers, vehicles, and payments. Ensure that all relationships are necessary and represent different meanings. Also, include the binary relationships as required. (15 marks)
